The '''Nebula Front''' squadron was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit of the militant wing serving [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] that fielded [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], the predecessor to the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]]. The fighter craft of the unit were painted white and marked with Nebula Front's blue logo on the wing panels. Made up of the veteran fighter [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], the best aces were occasionally selected to be attached to the [[Nebula Elite]], an exclusive squadron of the organization's top-ranking pilots.<ref name="SWPM">{{PocketModel|set=Scum & Villainy|cardname=Nebula Front Z-95 Headhunter|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipsv09c.jpg}}</ref>
